item.title: Rates, Routes and Rules Shift Across Markets
item.description: Fresh practical changes span payments, travel, energy, finance and infrastructure.
item.content:encoded:
Fresh practical changes span payments, travel, energy, finance and infrastructure.

  1. Australia ends card surcharges on major card networks From 1 October, Australian businesses can no longer add payment surcharges to Visa, Mastercard, American Express or eftpos card transactions; other non-payment-method fees can still apply. 03 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  2. G7 releases 100 million barrels from energy reserves G7 countries agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through the IEA, with implementation beginning immediately over four months. 02 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  3. Australia's cash rate reaches 4.60% The Reserve Bank of Australia raised the cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.60%, its fourth increase of 2026 and the highest level in 15 years. 29 Sep 2026. Source · Follow up
  4. Australia–Indonesia air capacity expands A revised bilateral agreement adds up to 5,000 weekly seats each way; Qantas and Jetstar announced new or expanded Perth–Jakarta, Western Sydney–Bali, Brisbane–Bali and Melbourne–Jakarta services. 03 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  5. Bali–Phuket flights become daily TransNusa's direct Bali–Phuket service increases from four weekly flights to daily service from 3 October, adding another direct option between two common Southeast Asian destinations. 03 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  6. Western Sydney Airport prepares for passenger opening Western Sydney International is scheduled to open to passengers on 25 October, with Air New Zealand beginning Auckland services the following day and the airport operating without a night curfew. 03 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  7. Euro-area inflation rises to 3.8% Eurostat's flash estimate puts September euro-area annual inflation at 3.8%, up from 3.2% in August. 02 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  8. SEC proposes crypto-custody framework for advisers The U.S. SEC proposed rules establishing a federal framework for investment advisers and funds holding crypto assets. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  9. FAA clears 737 MAX software issue as non-safety risk The FAA's review concluded a flight-computer software glitch on some 737 MAX aircraft does not pose a safety risk, removing an obstacle to MAX 10 certification. 02 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  10. Crew-13 reaches the International Space Station Four astronauts reached the ISS after an eight-hour SpaceX Crew Dragon flight, the quickest U.S. crew transfer to the station so far. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  11. Japan gets a planned $15 billion AI data-centre project JERA, Dell and RHAELM agreed to develop a 400 MW hyperscale AI data centre in Chiba, with phased operations planned from 2028. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  12. Romania opens first phase of Vifor wind farm Rezolv Energy inaugurated the 192 MW first phase of Vifor and is planning battery storage and possible solar additions; full capacity is planned at 461 MW. 02 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  13. Plaquemines LNG moves toward commercial service Venture Global asked U.S. regulators to authorize Phase 1 of its Plaquemines LNG facility for service, the final regulatory step before commercial operations. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  14. Amazon and Flipkart review unlicensed security cameras Amazon and Walmart-owned Flipkart began reviewing security-camera listings in India after unlicensed products were found on their marketplaces under newer testing requirements. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  15. Australia starts first phase of Thriving Kids support The first phase of Australia's Thriving Kids program began on 1 October, including expanded family information and a new national autism helpline. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  16. New Zealand details coming real-estate regulatory changes The Real Estate Authority published implementation guidance for Real Estate Agents Act amendments due on 9 March 2027, including wider document-request powers and an expanded unsatisfactory-conduct test. 02 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  17. Kenya breaks ground on $16 billion refinery Construction began on a $16 billion refinery at Lamu Port, with completion planned for 2030 and a proposed 700,000-barrel-per-day scale. 30 Sep 2026. Source · Follow up
  18. Development banks adopt common capital-mobilisation methods Thirty multilateral development banks and finance institutions launched joint methodologies for measuring private capital mobilised into emerging markets. 01 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
  19. Alaska Airlines expands planned long-haul Seattle network Alaska plans to grow Seattle intercontinental service to at least 15 routes by 2030, including new Paris and Athens services in 2027 using widebody aircraft. 02 Oct 2026. Source · Follow up
